card.name: Start of the word concentration
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word concentration or concentrate (Concent, cent, conce), usually at the start of a sentence or table header, before the rest of the word is spelled out.

modes.label: Sentence-initial Concent
modes.description: A new sentence or heading begins with the first piece of Concentration(s) or Concentrate.

modes.label: Inside compound or lowercase
modes.description: The first piece of concentration appears after a hyphen or inside a sentence, as in time-concentration curve.

card.writes: It suppresses the word concentration and related terms like dose, so the model does not repeat them, and weakly promotes the word medium.
card.plain: It marks the opening of the word concentration, just before the model finishes spelling it.
